query_plan.query: Which NBA team has the largest number of followers?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by team, select the team with the maximum number of followers.
steps.query: Return all nba teams together with their number of followers.

extra.sql_query: SELECT nba_teams.name FROM nba_teams WHERE nba_teams.followers = ( SELECT MAX(nba_teams.followers) FROM nba_teams )
